title: OsbRegimenOnboardExpectedStateV1
description: expectedTargetState of osb.regimen.onboard. Both values are live preconditions the OSB executor checks under its study writer lock, in the same native transaction as the regimen. studyVersion is passed as expected_study_version (the current draft version token, which detects lock transitions). protocolDocumentsContentHash is the current authored protocol document bundle hash, null when the study has none, and is passed as protocol_documents.expected_content_hash when the regimen saves documents. A mismatch writes nothing and is a terminal precondition failure, never a retry.

OsbStudyIdentity.description: The OSB study draft root the command targets. It must equal the platform study's single active verified OSB binding, to which the worker token is scoped.
